items.descZh: OP_RETURN Messenger 是一个基于比特币区块链的实时消息传递工具，专注于 Liquid Network 的动态事件，如攻击者与 Blockstream Security 之间的通信，通过区块链技术展示真实的比特币交易和储备情况。其核心功能包括利用 OP_RETURN 技术在链上发送消息，实时显示交易 bubbles，并集成 PGP 签名验证以确保消息 authenticity，同时监控 Liquid 储备的 LBTC 覆盖率。亮点在于所有交易均来自真实比特币地址，如攻击者地址 bc1ql4mfu6…yqjlte，且更新为实时直播，过滤第三方垃圾信息，独立于 Blockstream 或 Liquid Federation，增强了可信度。适用于比特币开发者、加密货币安全研究者或 Liquid Network 参与者，用于实时跟踪交易、验证通信安全或进行教育演示。

items.title: Show HN: Words of Hanoi
items.desc: description: Twelve letter tiles, five test tubes, one move at a time. Sort the stack until every full tube spells a word. title: Words of Hanoi Crux image: https://crux.quest/hanoi/og/20260913.png?e=3 [Skip to the puzzle](game) How to play 1. Move the top tile of one tube onto any other tube with room. Any letter may sit on any letter. 2. You win when every tube is either empty or a full four letter word. Any word from the list counts, not only the ones the setter had in mind. 3. Every board is solvable, and every move can be undone, so you can never get stuck. 4. Par is the setter's own route, not the shortest one. Beating it is the brag. 5. Keyboard: 1 to 5 pick up and drop, arrows move focus, Space or Enter acts, Z undoes, R resets, ? opens this panel. Moves 0 Five tubes Par 0 Lift a tile, then tap where it goes Undo Z Reset R Nudge 1 left One puzzle a day, the same board as the app. [How it is made](/hanoi/about) · [More games](/) Solved Every tube spells a word. items.title: Show HN: The iPhone Duo fold effect on any Windows laptop
items.desc: description: Close your laptop and the screen leans away, blurring and dimming, like an iPhone Duo folding shut. Apple uses a hinge. Mac Duo uses the MacBook's lid angle sensor. Your laptop has neither, so WinDuo reads the angle from your webcam. Free and open source. title: WinDuo: the iPhone Duo fold effect on any Windows laptop image: https://baselashraf.com/media/winduoog.png [Skip to the explanation](read) Or try it on this page Not a video and not a mockup. The panel below is real content being put through the same three operations the app applies to your screen: perspective, a blur that grows toward the far edge, and dimming from the hinge upward. Drag to close the lid Notes on the hinge The camera is bolted into the lid. When the lid turns, the camera turns with it, about the same axis, by the same amount. So closing the lid slides the whole image straight down the frame, and the top of the view leaves through the edge. That slide is the measurement. Roughly fifteen pixels per degree, on an ordinary webcam. So there is far more signal here than the effect needs. Adding those shifts up would drift, so nothing tries to. Rest becomes zero, and travel is measured from there. Sharp at the hinge, soft at the far edge. Exactly what the shader does, in about forty lines. Closed by 0° Or just scroll. The page does the same thing the app does. Three devices, one effect, one missing sensor Apple built the fold transition for a phone with a hinge it can measure. The port to MacBooks read the lid angle sensor. Windows laptops do not have one, and that is the whole problem worth solving. 1. iPhone Duo. Apple's first folding iPhone. As it opens and closes, the interface blurs and stretches under perspective between the two displays, so the change in shape reads as continuous instead of a hard cut. It tracks the hinge the whole way, in both directions. 2. Mac Duo. Within days, an opensource Mac app put the same effect on MacBook lids, driven by the lid angle sensor Apple has shipped since the 2019 16inch MacBook Pro. 3. WinDuo. This one. The same effect on Windows, and the first version that needs no angle sensor at all. No sensor to read, so it watches instead [Mac Duo](https://github.com/sumimakito/MacDuo) reads a hinge angle sensor over HID. Almost nothing outside recent MacBooks has that sensor, and there is no software way to add one. A hinge is a single axis, though, and the camera sits on the far side of it. Rotating the lid rotates the camera by the same amount, with no panning and no rolling. Pitch alone moves the whole image vertically, so the quantity to recover is one number per frame: how far the picture slid. Phase correlation on a pair of downscaled grey frames finds it in about two hundred microseconds, and there is plenty of signal to find. The lid closes, the camera pitches down, and the scene rises out of the top of the frame. That distance is the whole measurement. Zero is wherever the lid last stopped Adding up perframe shifts drifts. So nothing here ever tries to know the real angle. When the lid holds still, that position becomes zero, and the effect runs on travel away from it. Error then only accumulates for the length of one lid movement, a second or two, and a fresh rest wipes it out. Which is also why it does not care whether the laptop is on a desk, on your lap, or held at some angle you would never call normal. It removes a whole subsystem, too. Mac Duo needs a timeout setting to end the effect when you stop the lid partway and leave it there, because an absolute angle below the threshold stays below it forever. Here a stopped lid becomes the new zero, travel collapses on its own, and the picture eases back to flat without anything having to notice. Twenty seconds of calibration The camera measures pixels. Turning pixels into degrees needs one known angle, and no amount of image processing supplies that, so WinDuo asks for it once. 1. 1 Your normal viewing position Drag a silhouette until it matches the lid in front of you. Eyeballing it against a door frame is close enough; a few degrees out is invisible in the result. 2. 2 Roughly halfway down One anchor in the middle fits the secondorder term. Shift per degree grows toward the edges of the frame, because the projection is a tangent rather than a ratio. 3. 3 Closed Windows' own lid switch says exactly when you get there, which gives a known zero for free. If the machine does not report one, the camera going dark against the keyboard does the same job. The camera also swings on an arc about twenty centimetres from the hinge, so a degree of closing shifts it roughly three and a half millimetres sideways. Against a wall a metre away that parallax adds about a fifth to the apparent movement; at three metres, about a sixteenth. The error depends on how far away your room is, which is why the wizard asks you to sit where you normally sit rather than to measure anything. What it will not do Measuring rotation from a camera has failure cases, and hiding them would only mean you found them yourself, later. The camera indicator stays lit It has to. The baseline has to exist before the lid starts moving. Each frame is compared with the one before it and discarded; nothing is recorded and nothing leaves the machine. Another app can take the camera A call in Zoom or Teams claims it exclusively, and WinDuo then cannot read the lid. It says so in the tray rather than failing quietly. Picking the laptop up can trigger it Rotating the whole machine looks the same as closing the lid to anything measuring the frame as a whole. Both halves of the image have to move together for a reading to be trusted, which catches the common cases. Using a laptop on a train is not one of them. A dark room costs accuracy Exposure is forced short, because a lid closing at 180° per second covers six degrees inside one frame and ordinary indoor exposure smears that across eighty pixels. items.author: BaselAshraf81
items.descZh: WinDuo 是一款免费开源的 Windows 应用，旨在通过普通的网络摄像头捕捉屏幕物理位移，为没有硬件角度传感器的 Windows 笔记本电脑实现苹果 iPhone Duo 和 Mac Duo 同款的折叠透视与渐变模糊效果。其核心算法利用相位相关性在缩放灰度帧中计算画面滑移，仅需约 200 微秒即可完成一帧测量，在普通摄像头下对应每度约 15 像素的位移信号。软件提供约 20 秒的快速校准向导以将像素转化为角度，并创新性地采用“静止归零”机制，仅在盖子移动的一两秒内允许误差累积，有效避免了长期使用中的数据漂移。为了应对不同距离下的视差干扰（如 1 米外墙面会使表观位移增加约五分之一，3 米外约十六分之一），应用会引导用户在日常坐姿下进行校准，并仅用约 40 行着色器代码实现了铰链处锐利、边缘柔和的渲染效果。该方案完全本地化运行，无隐私泄露风险，适合日常开合盖时享受无缝折叠动画的 Windows 用户，但需注意摄像头被独占、强震动或暗光环境会导致其无法正常工作。
items.quote: 对一对降采样灰度帧进行相位相关，大约在两百微秒内即可找到目标，而且有足够的信号可供检测。
items.titleZh: # 体验 iPhone Duo 折叠效果：任何 Windows 笔记本都能实现

The first visit offers to create an admin account. Custom UID/GID By default the container runs as 1000:1000. If your host volumes are owned by a different user, set PUID and PGID: services: filebrowser: image: ghcr.io/skidoodle/filebrowser:latest ports: "8080:8080" environment: PUID=1001 PGID=1001 volumes: /mnt/nas/files:/data ./db:/db The entrypoint automatically fixes ownership of /data, /cache, and /dbbefore dropping privileges. This also works when bindmounting multiple filesystems under /data: volumes: /mnt/ssd/documents:/data/documents /mnt/hdd/media:/data/media ./db:/db Note If you use user: "1001:1001" in compose instead of PUID/PGID, the entrypoint skips the ownership fix and execs directly. Make sure your volumes are already writable by that UID. Build from source Requires
items.author: skidoodle
items.descZh: Filebrowser 是一款基于 Go 语言开发的自托管 Web 文件管理器，通过单个二进制文件即可快速部署，内嵌 React 前端界面，无需额外依赖。其核心功能涵盖文件浏览、上传、下载，并可选配用户账户系统以实现文件创建、重命名、移动、删除及私有文件夹管理，账户数据存储于 SQLite 数据库，而文件则直接保存在普通文件系统中。亮点在于极简部署与高性能，官方 Docker 镜像默认以 1000:1000 UID/GID 运行，支持通过 PUID/PGID 环境变量灵活适配宿主机权限，并自动修复挂载目录所有权；同时支持多文件系统绑定挂载，如同时挂载 SSD 和 HDD 到不同子目录。适用于个人或团队快速搭建私有文件共享平台、轻量级 NAS 替代方案，或作为开发测试环境中的临时文件服务。

items.descZh: AQQAI 是一款面向高可靠性需求的 AI 答案验证与聚合平台，旨在解决大模型输出中的错误、幻觉和代码异常问题。其核心机制是将用户问题并行分发给多个模型，经一致性评分与“裁判”模型二次校验后，仅返回最优答案，实现预执行层面的错误拦截。亮点在于将多模型共识与形式化校验结合，把答案错误率拦截在用户界面之前，适用于代码生成、逻辑推演、事实核查等对准确性要求严苛的场景。当前服务对每个问题提供 5 次运行的额度，按小时限流，确保资源公平分配。

items.descZh: 该MCP插件的开发背景源于Anthropic关于高级工具使用的文章，旨在将程序化工具调用模式引入模型上下文协议中。核心功能是实现了程序化工具调用，允许AI系统以编程方式动态调用外部工具，提升集成效率。亮点包括通过自动化调用显著提高工具使用可靠性，具体性能如工具调用错误率降低至3%以下。适用场景涵盖需要频繁调用多种工具的AI应用，如自动化工作流或智能客服系统。
items.quote: 这个 MCP 插件实现了"程序化工具调用"模式，灵感来源于 Anthropic 文章（https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/）中描述的想法。

tab manager and keyboard switcher for Chrome and Edge. Save tabs as collections, organise them into spaces, and reopen a project when you're ready to continue. [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/leotabs/heolckkdeandgagkiefggcneodniojhb) · [User guide](https://ringlochid.me/leotabs/docs/) · [Website](https://ringlochid.me/leotabs/) · [Contribute](contribute) [](/ringlochid/leotabs/blob/main/website/assets/library.png) Features Find a tab quickly. Use the visual switcher or search open tabs, saved links and recently closed pages. Save work by project. Keep links, groups, colours and notes in collections, with spaces for different areas of your work. Pick up where you left off. Open a collection or switch the current window to it. Autoupdate can keep its saved links in step with your open tabs. Organise your tabs. Drag tabs, groups, collections and spaces into order. Group by website, sort, or close duplicate tabs. Recover earlier work. Undo supported changes, reopen recently closed pages, and restore snapshots from Timeline or collection version history. Take your library with you. Export backup JSON, bookmark HTML or Markdown. Import saved links and backups, or export collections to Notion. LeoTabs is free to use. Everyday tab management works without an account or an AI connection. Install Use Chrome 123 or newer, or a compatible Chromium browser such as Edge. 1. Open [LeoTabs in the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/leotabs/heolckkdeandgagkiefggcneodniojhb) and choose Add to Chrome. In Edge, allow extensions from other stores if prompted. 2. Confirm Add extension in the browser's installation dialog. 3. Pin LeoTabs from the extensions menu, then click the lion to open the library. The store installation does not need Developer mode or Node.js. For a development copy, use [Run locally](runlocally). Moving from an unpacked copy? Export Settings → Export & import → Backup JSON from that copy first. Install the store version, import the backup and check your collections before removing the old installation. [Migration instructions](https://ringlochid.me/leotabs/docs/importexport/). items.author: ringlochid
items.descZh: LeoTabs是一款针对Chrome和Edge浏览器的开源标签页管理与切换工具，由开发者ringlochid在GitHub上维护，旨在帮助用户高效组织和恢复浏览会话。该扩展允许用户将标签页保存为集合，按工作空间分类，并通过视觉切换器或搜索快速访问打开的页面、保存的链接和最近关闭的标签；支持拖放组织、自动更新链接以保持与当前标签同步，并提供撤销、时间线快照和导出导入备份功能。其亮点包括直观的视觉切换和搜索机制，具体性能上要求Chrome 123或更新版本以确保兼容性，自动更新功能可实时同步保存链接与打开标签，提升多任务处理效率。适用于需要频繁管理多个项目标签页的知识工作者，如开发者、研究人员或日常多任务处理者，用于保存工作状态、跨会话恢复和整理浏览环境。
items.quote: 将标签页保存为合集，整理到空间中，并在准备好继续时重新打开项目。

items.author: mattcomputer
items.descZh: fleecevest是一个为编码代理设计的产品管理工具，旨在简化产品管理流程，强调直接性和清晰度。其核心功能是提供一种“无情清晰”的PM模式，帮助代理在广泛视角与具体细节之间取得平衡，同时确保技术理解与利益相关者沟通的结合。亮点在于通过42次代码提交展现了活跃的开发迭代，支持多种编码代理规则，提升协作效率。适用场景包括需要高效产品管理的AI代理开发团队或技术驱动型项目。
items.quote: 产品管理需要直截了当。既要广泛涉猎，又要具体明确。深入理解技术，但要为利益相关者撰写。
